Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: Employee_Manager.

Câu hỏi (Question): During data conversion in Mendix, which tools are used to map source data to the target domain model? (multiple answers are correct)
Đáp án A: Repositories
Đáp án B: Data Conversion Services
Đáp án C: Microflows
Đáp án D: Import Mapping
Đáp án E: Import Templates
Đáp án F: Nanoflows
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B, D, E): Đáp án chính xác là: Data Conversion Services / Import Mapping / Import Templates.

Câu hỏi (Question): Which of the following is NOT considered a static resource in Mendix?
Đáp án A: A CSS stylesheet
Đáp án B: An image file
Đáp án C: A microflow
Đáp án D: A JavaScript file
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: A microflow.

Câu hỏi (Question): What are the four stages of data conversion?
Đáp án A: Extend domain model
Đáp án B: Verify data integrity
Đáp án C: Clean up database
Đáp án D: Deploy and convert
Đáp án E: Model the conversion
Đáp án F: Clean up model
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A, D, E, F): Đáp án chính xác là: Extend domain model / Deploy and convert / Model the conversion / Clean up model.

Câu hỏi (Question): In Mendix, what is the primary purpose of using Import Mappings during data conversion?
Đáp án A: To deploy the application to different environments.
Đáp án B: To define user roles and permissions.
Đáp án C: To create new associations between entities.
Đáp án D: To generate user interface components.
Đáp án E: To manage database transactions.
Đáp án F: To map source data fields to target domain model attributes.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (F): Đáp án chính xác là: To map source data fields to target domain model attributes..

Câu hỏi (Question): The Mendix Client is:
Đáp án A: A server-side application that handles logic and data processing.
Đáp án B: Built on a combination of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and runs in your browser.
Đáp án C: A lightweight desktop application that runs natively on Windows and Mac.
Đáp án D: A combination of native mobile and desktop technologies.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: Built on a combination of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and runs in your browser..

Câu hỏi (Question): Why is it a best practice to redeploy your app after cleaning up the model?
Đáp án A: To avoid complex synchronization issues during future deployments.
Đáp án B: To ensure any code or database changes are properly reflected in the deployment pipeline.
Đáp án C: To improve application performance by reducing redundancy.
Đáp án D: To test if the new features are functioning correctly before cleaning up.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: To avoid complex synchronization issues during future deployments..

Câu hỏi (Question): What is the default value of the attribute DeleteAfterDownload?
Đáp án A: true
Đáp án B: false
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: false.

Câu hỏi (Question): Static resources in Mendix:
Đáp án A: Are transmitted as raw HTML to the client.
Đáp án B: Include stylesheets transmitted in CSS format to the client.
Đáp án C: Are limited to JavaScript files.
Đáp án D: Can only be accessed via the server's filesystem.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: Include stylesheets transmitted in CSS format to the client..

Câu hỏi (Question): What does the function reverse() do?
Đáp án A: It changes the direction in which the association is queried.
Đáp án B: It removes the association from the domain model.
Đáp án C: It resets the association to its default state.
Đáp án D: It creates a copy of the association with reversed properties.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: It changes the direction in which the association is queried..

Câu hỏi (Question): Why is it a best practice to create a specialization of the FileDocument and Image entities?
Đáp án A: It allows for better security and property configuration based on purpose.
Đáp án B: It reduces file storage size.
Đáp án C: It prevents the need for storing files in a different database.
Đáp án D: It simplifies file access permissions.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: It allows for better security and property configuration based on purpose..

Câu hỏi (Question): What will happen to the ID's after generalizing the Player and Staff entities by the Person entity?
Đáp án A: The ID's of Player and Staff will remain independent from the Person table.
Đáp án B: The ID's of Player and Staff will keep their own set and sequence and will equal the ID in the Person table.
Đáp án C: The ID's of Player and Staff will be merged into a single sequence shared by both.
Đáp án D: The ID's of Player and Staff will not be linked to the Person table.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: The ID's of Player and Staff will keep their own set and sequence and will equal the ID in the Person table..

Câu hỏi (Question): The Communication between the Mendix Runtime and Database Server:
Đáp án A: Uses REST API calls for communication with the database.
Đáp án B: Includes communication between the supported database servers using JDBC.
Đáp án C: Uses HTTP requests to communicate with the database server.
Đáp án D: Uses direct socket communication between Mendix and the database.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: Includes communication between the supported database servers using JDBC..

Câu hỏi (Question): The app performance is affected by a reference set (both) because:
Đáp án A: Both entities needs to be joined with the reference table and data transfer increases.
Đáp án B: Only one entity needs to be joined with the reference table.
Đáp án C: Only the reference table is accessed.
Đáp án D: Data transfer does not increase.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: Both entities needs to be joined with the reference table and data transfer increases..

Câu hỏi (Question): What type of domain model changes can have an impact on the data in the database?
Đáp án A: Type changes and Structural changes
Đáp án B: Behavioral changes
Đáp án C: Security changes
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: Type changes and Structural changes.

Câu hỏi (Question): Which of the following databases is NOT supported by Mendix for runtime communication?
Đáp án A: Oracle
Đáp án B: MongoDB
Đáp án C: MySQL
Đáp án D: PostgreSQL
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: MongoDB.

Câu hỏi (Question): Is there ever a reason to retrieve an object from database instead of over association?
Đáp án A: Yes, in cases where constraints other than a single association are applicable or where stored database values are required.
Đáp án B: Yes, but only when the association doesn't exist.
Đáp án C: No, retrieval by association always covers all use cases.
Đáp án D: No, retrieval from the database is always slower and should be avoided.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: Yes, in cases where constraints other than a single association are applicable or where stored database values are required..

Câu hỏi (Question): In which microflow will the combination retrieve and aggregation be optimized?
Đáp án A: C (aggregation is performed outside the retrieve activity)
Đáp án B: B (aggregated list used in multiple places in flow)
Đáp án C: A (aggregated list not used later in flow)
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: A (aggregated list not used later in flow).

Câu hỏi (Question): Where are the file(s) or image(s) stored by default?
Đáp án A: In the Mendix cloud storage
Đáp án B: In an external file storage system
Đáp án C: On the user’s local machine
Đáp án D: On the file server located on the application server
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: On the file server located on the application server.

Câu hỏi (Question): Which of the following is not a possible source of data for a microflow?
Đáp án A: A list of objects returned from another microflow.
Đáp án B: An entity retrieved from the database.
Đáp án C: A page passed as input parameter by another microflow.
Đáp án D: A value passed as an input parameter.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: A page passed as input parameter by another microflow..

Câu hỏi (Question): Nick in the Amsterdam time zone [UTC +2] selects 07/11/2020 in a date picker for a non- localized attribute. What will be the date value if Nick converts it to a string in a microflow using formatDateTime?
Đáp án A: Correct: When the non-localized attribute is converted to a string using formatDateTime in a microflow, it reflects the local timezone (UTC +2).
Đáp án B: Incorrect: This time is unrelated to the expected behavior for non-localized attributes in the local timezone.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: Correct: When the non-localized attribute is converted to a string using formatDateTime in a microflow, it reflects the local timezone (UTC +2)..

Câu hỏi (Question): What is NOT an advantage of using the database source option versus the XPath option?
Đáp án A: The database source option provides better performance for simple queries.
Đáp án B: The database source option can be used to specify constraints that span entities.
Đáp án C: The database source option offers more flexibility for complex queries.
Đáp án D: The database source option is easier to use for beginners.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: The database source option can be used to specify constraints that span entities..

Câu hỏi (Question): What is the best naming for a self-reference where the buddy is referenced by an apprentice?
Đáp án A: Buddy_ApprenticeRef
Đáp án B: Apprentice_Buddy
Đáp án C: Buddy_Apprentice
Đáp án D: Apprentice_BuddyRef
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: Apprentice_Buddy.

Câu hỏi (Question): Adrian wants to select a staff member for a team. Which domain model would be suitable?
Đáp án A: Staff * -> * Team
Đáp án B: Staff * <- * Team
Đáp án C: Staff 1 -> * Team
Đáp án D: Staff * -> 1 Team
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: Staff * <- * Team.

Câu hỏi (Question): Localizing a DateTime attribute has an effect on:
Đáp án A: Incorrect: Localizing a DateTime attribute has no effect on network latency.
Đáp án B: Database schema
Đáp án C: Client representation
Đáp án D: Correct: Localizing a DateTime attribute only affects how the date is represented on the client side.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: Correct: Localizing a DateTime attribute only affects how the date is represented on the client side..

Câu hỏi (Question): When localize is set to No, the date displayed in the client is based on the:
Đáp án A: Database format
Đáp án B: Correct: When 'localize' is set to No, the date is displayed in UTC, not based on the client's timezone.
Đáp án C: Incorrect: The server's timezone does not impact the display when 'localize' is set to No.
Đáp án D: UTC value
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: Correct: When 'localize' is set to No, the date is displayed in UTC, not based on the client's timezone..

Câu hỏi (Question): What is an important rule to keep in mind when creating effective indexes?
Đáp án A: The index should have the same order of attributes defined as in search and retrieve queries in order to be available for queries.
Đáp án B: The index should contain as many attributes as possible to optimize performance.
Đáp án C: Indexes should be created on all foreign key columns to optimize join queries.
Đáp án D: The index should include attributes that are most frequently used in sorting.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: The index should have the same order of attributes defined as in search and retrieve queries in order to be available for queries..

Câu hỏi (Question): What does the following XPath query return? //Product [OrderManagement.OrderLine_Product/OrderManagement.OrderLine/OrderMa nagement.OrderLine_Order != $Order]
Đáp án A: All products that have never been ordered.
Đáp án B: All products that have been ordered exactly once.
Đáp án C: All products that have been ordered more than once.
Đáp án D: All the products that are ordered at least once, but not on the affected order.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: All the products that are ordered at least once, but not on the affected order..

Câu hỏi (Question): When a user selects a date for a non-localized DateTime attribute in Mendix, how is the selected date stored in the database relative to the user's time zone?
Đáp án A: It is converted to the server's local time zone before storage.
Đáp án B: It is adjusted to UTC before storage.
Đáp án C: It is stored with the user's time zone information.
Đáp án D: It is converted to the application's default time zone.
Đáp án E: It is stored as the user selected, without time zone conversion.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (E): Đáp án chính xác là: It is stored as the user selected, without time zone conversion..

Câu hỏi (Question): What happens when you apply an index?
Đáp án A: The speed of Read actions will increase.
Đáp án B: The size of the database will decrease.
Đáp án C: The speed of Write actions will increase.
Đáp án D: The speed of both Read and Write actions will decrease.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: The speed of Read actions will increase..

Câu hỏi (Question): Which of the following is NOT a benefit that XPath provides to the Mendix Platform?
Đáp án A: XPath allows for complex queries across multiple entities.
Đáp án B: XPath simplifies the data querying process.
Đáp án C: XPath can be used to automatically generate pages and widgets to show data on.
Đáp án D: XPath improves performance by filtering data on the database side.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: XPath can be used to automatically generate pages and widgets to show data on..

Câu hỏi (Question): What is the result of generalizing the Player entity by the Person entity?
Đáp án A: A single table containing attributes from both entities
Đáp án B: One table with a subset of attributes from the generalized entity
Đáp án C: No change; Player and Person remain independent
Đáp án D: Two tables, one per entity
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: Two tables, one per entity.

Câu hỏi (Question): Type changes and Security changes
Đáp án A: Structural changes and Style changes
Đáp án B: Type changes and Security changes
Đáp án C: Security changes and Name changes
Đáp án D: Type changes and Structural changes
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: Type changes and Structural changes.

Câu hỏi (Question): Which statement is correct?
Đáp án A: A 1-1 association is an IS and inheritance is an HAS type of relation.
Đáp án B: A 1-1 association and inheritance are both an IS type of relation.
Đáp án C: A 1-1 association is a HAS and inheritance is an IS type of relation.
Đáp án D: A 1-1 association and inheritance are both an HAS type of relation.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: A 1-1 association is a HAS and inheritance is an IS type of relation..

Câu hỏi (Question): When you want to show a list of shipped orders, will the Database data source generate a different request than the XPath data source option?
Đáp án A: The XPath data source can be less performant than the database option for large datasets.
Đáp án B: No, the database data source will always lead to the same request as the XPath data source.
Đáp án C: The database source option provides more granular control over the queries generated.
Đáp án D: Yes, the database data source generates different requests for data than XPath.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: No, the database data source will always lead to the same request as the XPath data source..

Câu hỏi (Question): How does setting the "Localize" property to Yes affect the display of DateTime attributes in Mendix?
Đáp án A: Dates remain in UTC but are displayed without conversion.
Đáp án B: DateTime attributes are ignored by the client application.
Đáp án C: DateTime values are adjusted and displayed based on the user's local time zone.
Đáp án D: Dates are formatted according to the server's locale settings.
Đáp án E: Dates are stored in the client's local time zone.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: DateTime values are adjusted and displayed based on the user's local time zone..

Câu hỏi (Question): What happens to DateTime attributes in Mendix when the "Localize" property is set to No?
Đáp án A: DateTime attributes are deleted after being displayed.
Đáp án B: DateTime attributes are displayed based on the server's UTC value without conversion.
Đáp án C: DateTime values are hidden from the client application.
Đáp án D: The server automatically adjusts DateTime values based on global settings.
Đáp án E: DateTime values are converted to the client's local time zone before display.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: DateTime attributes are displayed based on the server's UTC value without conversion..

Câu hỏi (Question): Jane in the Amsterdam time zone [UTC +2] selects 07/11/2020 in a date picker for a non-localized attribute. What will be the value stored in the database?
Đáp án A: Correct: Since the attribute is non-localized, the exact value Jane selects will be stored in the database without any time zoneconversion.
Đáp án D: Incorrect: This value does not correspond to any expected behavior for a non-localized attribute.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: Correct: Since the attribute is non-localized, the exact value Jane selects will be stored in the database without any time zoneconversion..

Câu hỏi (Question): Inheritance is used to:
Đáp án A: Inherit the structure and behavior of an entity, so that all specializations can be used individually within the same process.
Đáp án B: Remove the need for specialized entities in the domain model.
Đáp án C: Allow unrelated entities to share attributes and associations.
Đáp án D: Combine multiple entities into a single entity to reduce complexity.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: Inherit the structure and behavior of an entity, so that all specializations can be used individually within the same process..

Câu hỏi (Question): Which of the following best describes the Mendix Client's role in a Mendix application architecture?
Đáp án A: It acts as a middleware between the server and the database.
Đáp án B: It provides native desktop applications for Windows and Mac.
Đáp án C: It solely handles server-side logic and data processing.
Đáp án D: It stores and retrieves data from the database directly.
Đáp án E: It manages the front-end interface and interacts with server-side components.
Đáp án F: It automates the deployment process across different environments.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (E): Đáp án chính xác là: It manages the front-end interface and interacts with server-side components..

Câu hỏi (Question): Which Mendix feature allows developers to automate the deployment process across different environments?
Đáp án A: Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines
Đáp án B: Import Templates
Đáp án C: Domain Model Synchronization
Đáp án D: Microflows
Đáp án E: Nanoflows
Đáp án F: Theme Management
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.

Câu hỏi (Question): What relationship type should be used in the domain model to represent that each order must have exactly one customer, but a customer can have multiple orders?
Đáp án A: One-to-One
Đáp án B: Aggregation
Đáp án C: One-to-Many
Đáp án D: Composition
Đáp án E: Inheritance
Đáp án F: Many-to-Many
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: One-to-Many.

Câu hỏi (Question): In Mendix, if a Staff entity has a one-to-many association with an ID entity, what is the result of this association?
Đáp án A: A single Staff object in the ID entity.
Đáp án B: A list of Staff objects in the ID entity.
Đáp án C: A list of ID's in the Staff object.
Đáp án D: A single Staff ID in the Staff object.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: A list of ID's in the Staff object..

Câu hỏi (Question): If both the App and User time zones are set, the value of the localized DateTime attribute displayed in the client depends on:
Đáp án A: Incorrect: Only the Client (user's) time zone is relevant when displaying localized DateTime attributes.
Đáp án B: Correct: The displayed value of a localized DateTime attribute depends on the client's (user's) time zone, regardless of the App time zone.
Đáp án C: Server's time zone
Đáp án D: The Client time zone
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: Correct: The displayed value of a localized DateTime attribute depends on the client's (user's) time zone, regardless of the App time zone..

Câu hỏi (Question): Is the following statement true or false? By association will always be an in- memory retrieve.
Đáp án A: True, retrieves by association are always in-memory operations.
Đáp án B: False, if objects aren't available in memory, a retrieve by association will automatically result in a database retrieve.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: False, if objects aren't available in memory, a retrieve by association will automatically result in a database retrieve..

Câu hỏi (Question): What is the correct XPath to retrieve the manager of an employee?
Đáp án A: [reversed(Employee_Manager) = '[%CurrentObject%]']
Đáp án B: [Employee.Manager = '[%CurrentObject%]']
Đáp án C: [Employee.Manager [reversed()] = '[%CurrentObject%]']
Đáp án D: [Employee.Manager = '[%CurrentObject%]']
Đáp án E: [Employee_Manager [reversed()] = '[%CurrentObject%]']
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: [reversed(Employee_Manager) = '[%CurrentObject%]'].

Câu hỏi (Question): What is the correct XPath to retrieve the goals of the buddy of an apprentice?
Đáp án A: [SoccerSquad.Player/SoccerSquad.Goal_Player/SoccerSquad.Apprentice_Buddy [reversed()] = '[%CurrentObject%]']
Đáp án B: [SoccerSquad.Goal_Player/SoccerSquad.Player/SoccerSquad.Buddy_Apprentice [reversed()] = '[%CurrentObject%]']
Đáp án C: [SoccerSquad.Goal_Player/SoccerSquad.Player/SoccerSquad.Apprentice_Buddy [reversed()] = '[%CurrentObject%]']
Đáp án D: [SoccerSquad.Goal_Player/SoccerSquad.Apprentice_Buddy [reversed()] = '[%CurrentObject%]']
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: [SoccerSquad.Goal_Player/SoccerSquad.Player/SoccerSquad.Apprentice_Buddy [reversed()] = '[%CurrentObject%]'].

Câu hỏi (Question): How does Mendix determine the time zone to display a localized DateTime attribute when both the application and the user have specific time zones configured?
Đáp án A: It prompts the user to select a preferred time zone.
Đáp án B: It uses the application's configured time zone.
Đáp án C: It averages the application's and user's time zones.
Đáp án D: It uses the user's (client's) time zone.
Đáp án E: It defaults to UTC.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D, E): Đáp án chính xác là: It uses the user's (client's) time zone. / It defaults to UTC..

Câu hỏi (Question): You want to prevent a specific user role from creating objects of entity 'Invoice', but they must be able to view them. How do you configure this?
Đáp án A: Add a validation rule "If user is role X, return false".
Đáp án B: Remove the module from the user's profile.
Đáp án C: Use a Nanoflow to block creation.
Đáp án D: Hide the 'New' button on the page.
Đáp án E: Set the entity to 'Read-only' in the Domain Model.
Đáp án F: In the Module Security > Entity Access tab for that Role, grant 'Read' access but uncheck 'Write' (Create/Delete).
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (F): Đáp án chính xác là: In the Module Security > Entity Access tab for that Role, grant 'Read' access but uncheck 'Write' (Create/Delete)..

Câu hỏi (Question): You have a Microflow that calls an external REST service. The service takes 10 seconds to respond. Users complain the UI is "frozen" during this time. What is the best way to improve the User Experience?
Đáp án A: Optimize the external service.
Đáp án B: Cache the REST response.
Đáp án C: Use a 'Progress Bar' widget that blocks the screen.
Đáp án D: Execute the REST call asynchronously using the 'Task Queue' or a 'Background Thread' via a Java Action, and notify the user when done.
Đáp án E: Reduce the timeout setting on the REST call to 1 second.
Đáp án F: Run the Microflow as 'Client-side'.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: Execute the REST call asynchronously using the 'Task Queue' or a 'Background Thread' via a Java Action, and notify the user when done..

Câu hỏi (Question): You are configuring a Task Queue to process heavy background jobs. You need to ensure that if a job fails due to a temporary database lock, it is retried automatically. How do you configure this?
Đáp án A: Use the 'Schedule Event' activity to reschedule the job immediately.
Đáp án B: Enable 'Retry' in the Task Queue configuration and specify the number of retries and interval.
Đáp án C: Use a 'While' loop in the calling microflow to wait for completion.
Đáp án D: Add a loop with a 'Sleep' activity in the microflow to retry manually.
Đáp án E: Configure the database to auto-retry transactions.
Đáp án F: Wrap the microflow in a 'Try-Catch' block and recursively call the microflow in the Catch section.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: Enable 'Retry' in the Task Queue configuration and specify the number of retries and interval..

Câu hỏi (Question): What does System.FileDocument store in the Contents attribute?
Đáp án A: It stores the URL to download the file.
Đáp án B: It stores the text content of the file only.
Đáp án C: It stores the XML representation.
Đáp án D: It stores the file path on the server.
Đáp án E: It stores the binary content of the file (Blob).
Đáp án F: It stores the metadata (Name, Size).
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (E): Đáp án chính xác là: It stores the binary content of the file (Blob)..

Câu hỏi (Question): You want to display a list of 'Products'. The user should be able to search by 'Category' AND 'Price Range' simultaneously. How do you structure the Data Grid search?
Đáp án A: Add multiple 'Search Field' widgets to the Data Grid control bar. Mendix automatically ANDs them together.
Đáp án B: Enable 'Multi-search' in the grid properties.
Đáp án C: Use a 'Snippet' for the search.
Đáp án D: You must write a custom OQL query.
Đáp án E: You need to use a Microflow data source.
Đáp án F: You can only search by one field at a time.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: Add multiple 'Search Field' widgets to the Data Grid control bar. Mendix automatically ANDs them together..

Câu hỏi (Question): In a high-security application, you want to prevent users from seeing the 'Salary' attribute of the 'Employee' entity in the Client API (Redux store), even if they have access to the 'Employee' object. How do you achieve this?
Đáp án A: Use a separate entity for Salary.
Đáp án B: Encrypt the data in the database.
Đáp án C: Disable the 'Client API' for the entire app.
Đáp án D: Use a 'microflow' to retrieve the data and remove the attribute.
Đáp án E: Configure 'Member Read Access' for the 'Salary' attribute to 'None' for that specific Module Role in the Domain Model.
Đáp án F: Hide the input widget on the page using 'Visible' property.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (E): Đáp án chính xác là: Configure 'Member Read Access' for the 'Salary' attribute to 'None' for that specific Module Role in the Domain Model..

Câu hỏi (Question): You want to expose a dataset via OData for consumption by business intelligence tools (like PowerBI or Tableau). What is the requirement for the Entity to be exposed?
Đáp án A: The entity must be part of a 'Published OData Service' resource in Studio Pro.
Đáp án B: The entity must have a 'System.Owner' attribute.
Đáp án C: The entity must be indexed.
Đáp án D: You must install the 'OData Connector' from the Marketplace.
Đáp án E: The entity must be 'Non-Persistable'.
Đáp án F: The entity must be in the 'Administration' module.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: The entity must be part of a 'Published OData Service' resource in Studio Pro..

Câu hỏi (Question): You need to implement a "Deep Link" that allows users to click a link in an email (e.g., myapp.com/link/resetpassword/TOKEN) and be taken directly to a password reset page, bypassing the standard login screen (if the token is valid). How is this achieved securely?
Đáp án A: Create a separate Mendix app just for the reset page.
Đáp án B: Configure the Deep Link module to allow "Anonymous" access for this specific link handler, and validate the token in the Microflow.
Đáp án C: Pass the username and password in the URL parameters.
Đáp án D: Use a standard 'Link Button' widget.
Đáp án E: Use the 'admin' user to execute the link automatically.
Đáp án F: Set the Project Security level to 'Off'.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: Configure the Deep Link module to allow "Anonymous" access for this specific link handler, and validate the token in the Microflow..

Câu hỏi (Question): You have a Microflow variable $Account and you want to cast it to its specialization $Admin. How do you do this?
Đáp án A: Use a Java Action to rewrite the memory.
Đáp án B: Rename the variable to $Admin.
Đáp án C: Retrieve the object again from the database.
Đáp án D: Use the 'Cast Object' activity (Inheritance Split) or check is-a in a decision.
Đáp án E: Use the 'Change Object' activity.
Đáp án F: You cannot cast objects in Mendix.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: Use the 'Cast Object' activity (Inheritance Split) or check is-a in a decision..

Câu hỏi (Question): You are optimizing an XPath retrieval in a microflow. You have the query: //Sales.Order[Status = 'Open'][Total > 1000]. You want to ensure Mendix generates the most efficient SQL query. How does Mendix process these constraints?
Đáp án A: You must use [Status = 'Open' and Total > 1000] inside a single bracket for it to be efficient.
Đáp án B: It depends on whether the list is sorted.
Đáp án C: The order of brackets matters: [Total > 1000] should come first for performance.
Đáp án D: Mendix executes two separate queries and intersects the results.
Đáp án E: Mendix merges these into a single SQL 'WHERE' clause: WHERE Status = 'Open' AND Total > 1000.
Đáp án F: Mendix retrieves all 'Open' orders first, then filters for 'Total > 1000' in memory.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (E): Đáp án chính xác là: Mendix merges these into a single SQL 'WHERE' clause: WHERE Status = 'Open' AND Total > 1000..

Câu hỏi (Question): When branching a line in a Microflow based on an enumeration value, what must be true to avoid a validation error?
Đáp án A: You must handle all possible enumeration values (either explicitly or via a 'Default' path).
Đáp án B: You cannot split on enumerations.
Đáp án C: You can only have 2 outgoing paths (True/False).
Đáp án D: The enumeration must be sorted.
Đáp án E: You must use a 'Split' activity.
Đáp án F: The paths must merge back together immediately.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: You must handle all possible enumeration values (either explicitly or via a 'Default' path)..

Câu hỏi (Question): How do you debug a specific Microflow in the Production environment (Mendix Cloud)?
Đáp án A: Download the database and run it locally.
Đáp án B: Connect Studio Pro to the Production URL and click 'Debug'.
Đáp án C: Use the 'Live Debugger' tool in the Developer Portal.
Đáp án D: Use the 'Mendix Agent' to pause the thread.
Đáp án E: You cannot attach the debugger to Production. You must rely on Logs or reproduce the issue in a Test environment.
Đáp án F: Enable 'Trace' log level for everything.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (E): Đáp án chính xác là: You cannot attach the debugger to Production. You must rely on Logs or reproduce the issue in a Test environment..

Câu hỏi (Question): Which XPath constraint correctly retrieves all 'Orders' created by the 'CurrentUser'?
Đáp án A: [System.Owner = '[%CurrentUser%]']
Đáp án B: [System.changedBy = '[%CurrentUser%]']
Đáp án C: [Owner = '[%CurrentUser%]']
Đáp án D: [Order_User = '[%CurrentUser%]']
Đáp án E: [id = '[%CurrentUser%]']
Đáp án F: [CreatedBy = '[%CurrentUser%]']
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: [System.Owner = '[%CurrentUser%]'].

Câu hỏi (Question): You have a Microflow with a 'Retrieve' activity. The source is 'Database'. You set the 'Range' to 'First'. What is the result?
Đáp án A: It returns the first object created in the database (ID 1).
Đáp án B: It returns a List containing one object.
Đáp án C: It returns a random object.
Đáp án D: It returns a single Object (not a List). If no object is found, it returns 'Empty' (null).
Đáp án E: It throws an error if no object is found.
Đáp án F: It returns the object with the highest ID.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: It returns a single Object (not a List). If no object is found, it returns 'Empty' (null)..

Câu hỏi (Question): What is the function of the addRefreshClass(context, "Module.Entity") Java Action often seen in custom code?
Đáp án A: It reloads the security constraints.
Đáp án B: It restarts the module.
Đáp án C: It refreshes the Java source code.
Đáp án D: It clears the database cache.
Đáp án E: It adds a new CSS class to the entity.
Đáp án F: It instructs the Client (Browser) to refresh any widgets displaying data from 'Module.Entity'.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (F): Đáp án chính xác là: It instructs the Client (Browser) to refresh any widgets displaying data from 'Module.Entity'..

Câu hỏi (Question): Which of the following is a valid use case for a 'Generalized' (Inherited) entity structure?
Đáp án A: You want to create a copy of the 'System.User' entity.
Đáp án B: You need to improve performance of a large table.
Đáp án C: You want to link 'Customer' to 'Invoices'.
Đáp án D: You want to simplify the security rules.
Đáp án E: You want to export data to Excel.
Đáp án F: You have 'Car' and 'Truck' entities that share many attributes (Color, Brand) and logic, so they both inherit from a 'Vehicle' entity.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (F): Đáp án chính xác là: You have 'Car' and 'Truck' entities that share many attributes (Color, Brand) and logic, so they both inherit from a 'Vehicle' entity..

Câu hỏi (Question): You have a 'Calculated Attribute' named TotalScore. You want to sort a Data Grid by this column. Why is the header not clickable for sorting?
Đáp án A: You forgot to enable 'Sortable' in the grid properties.
Đáp án B: You need to use a List View instead.
Đáp án C: Sorting by calculated attributes is not supported in the database because the value does not exist in the table; it is computed in Java memory after retrieval.
Đáp án D: The attribute type is Decimal, which cannot be sorted.
Đáp án E: You need to add an index to the calculated attribute.
Đáp án F: The Data Grid is read-only.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: Sorting by calculated attributes is not supported in the database because the value does not exist in the table; it is computed in Java memory after retrieval..

Câu hỏi (Question): You are configuring a 'Call REST Service' action. You want to send a file (binary) to the external API. How do you configure the Request?
Đáp án A: Select 'Binary' for the Request Body and map a System.FileDocument object.
Đáp án B: Use a Java Action to read the file from disk.
Đáp án C: Send the file path only.
Đáp án D: Convert the file to a Base64 string and send it as JSON.
Đáp án E: It is not possible to send files; only text.
Đáp án F: Use a 'Multipart/form-data' mapping with a string parameter.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: Select 'Binary' for the Request Body and map a System.FileDocument object..

Câu hỏi (Question): When using the 'Batch Replace' function in Studio Pro, what are you modifying?
Đáp án A: You are merging changes from another branch.
Đáp án B: You are replacing the default home page.
Đáp án C: You are replacing data in the database.
Đáp án D: You are replacing the Mendix Runtime version.
Đáp án E: You can search for a specific value (e.g., a caption, a variable name, or an XPath) across the entire model and replace it.
Đáp án F: You are swapping the CSS theme.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (E): Đáp án chính xác là: You can search for a specific value (e.g., a caption, a variable name, or an XPath) across the entire model and replace it..

Câu hỏi (Question): You are debugging a 'StackOverflowError' in a Microflow. What is the most common cause?
Đáp án A: Using too many variables in one microflow.
Đáp án B: Calling a REST service that returns a 500 error.
Đáp án C: Retrieving too many objects from the database.
Đáp án D: Infinite recursion: The microflow calls itself (or a sub-microflow calls the parent) without a terminating condition.
Đáp án E: A committed object triggers an 'After Commit' event that changes the object and commits again.
Đáp án F: A loop that runs 10,000 times.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: Infinite recursion: The microflow calls itself (or a sub-microflow calls the parent) without a terminating condition..

Câu hỏi (Question): You have a page with a 'Data View' listening to a 'List View'. When the user selects an item in the list, the Data View updates. However, you want the Data View to be editable ONLY if the selected item has status 'Draft'. How do you implement this?
Đáp án A: Use CSS to disable the inputs.
Đáp án B: Use a specialized 'Snippet' for Draft items.
Đáp án C: Use a Nanoflow to enable/disable the widgets.
Đáp án D: Use a Microflow to open a different page.
Đáp án E: Use a 'Conditional Editability' configuration on the Data View (or its input widgets) based on the attribute value 'Status'.
Đáp án F: Apply Entity Access rules to restrict 'Write' access.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (E): Đáp án chính xác là: Use a 'Conditional Editability' configuration on the Data View (or its input widgets) based on the attribute value 'Status'..

Câu hỏi (Question): You are implementing a 'Scheduled Event' that needs to generate a PDF for every user and email it. This takes 2 minutes per user, and you have 10,000 users. What is the correct architecture?
Đáp án A: The Scheduled Event should create 'Job' objects (one per user) and add them to a Task Queue for parallel processing.
Đáp án B: Increase the timeout of the Scheduled Event to 400 hours.
Đáp án C: Send all emails in one huge batch.
Đáp án D: Use a 'Loop' in the Scheduled Event.
Đáp án E: Run the event on the client side.
Đáp án F: Use a 'Sub-microflow' to speed it up.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: The Scheduled Event should create 'Job' objects (one per user) and add them to a Task Queue for parallel processing..

Câu hỏi (Question): Which of the following best describes a 'Cross-Module Association'?
Đáp án A: It is forbidden in Mendix.
Đáp án B: It forces the entities to use the same database table.
Đáp án C: It always results in a compilation error.
Đáp án D: It requires a special license.
Đáp án E: It is only possible if both modules are in the same folder.
Đáp án F: An association between entities in different modules. Mendix automatically manages the foreign keys, but you should minimize these to maintain module independence.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (F): Đáp án chính xác là: An association between entities in different modules. Mendix automatically manages the foreign keys, but you should minimize these to maintain module independence..

Câu hỏi (Question): What is the result of using empty in an XPath constraint like [EndDate = empty]?
Đáp án A: It retrieves objects where EndDate is today.
Đáp án B: It retrieves objects where 'EndDate' is an empty string.
Đáp án C: It retrieves all objects.
Đáp án D: It throws an error; you should use NULL.
Đáp án E: It retrieves objects where the 'EndDate' attribute is null.
Đáp án F: It deletes the empty records.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (E): Đáp án chính xác là: It retrieves objects where the 'EndDate' attribute is null..

Câu hỏi (Question): What is the primary purpose of 'Nanoflow Commons' module?
Đáp án A: It provides common CSS styles.
Đáp án B: It is a required system module for any app.
Đáp án C: It provides a set of standard JavaScript actions (like checking connectivity, getting location, native dialogs) for use in Nanoflows.
Đáp án D: It allows Nanoflows to run on the server.
Đáp án E: It converts Microflows to Nanoflows.
Đáp án F: It manages the database sync.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: It provides a set of standard JavaScript actions (like checking connectivity, getting location, native dialogs) for use in Nanoflows..

Câu hỏi (Question): A Native Mobile application needs to synchronize data. You have an entity 'Inspections' that is created on the device. When the device goes online and syncs, you want the server to validate the data before committing it to the main database. What is the correct approach?
Đáp án A: Configure the synchronization mode to 'Validate Only'.
Đáp án B: Use a 'Before Commit' event handler or validation logic in the microflow called by the synchronization process.
Đáp án C: rely on the database constraints (Not Null) only.
Đáp án D: Use a 'After Commit' event to delete invalid data.
Đáp án E: Use a 'Microflow' widget on the page to validate.
Đáp án F: Use a Nanoflow to validate the data on the server.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: Use a 'Before Commit' event handler or validation logic in the microflow called by the synchronization process..

Câu hỏi (Question): What is the significance of the _1 in a generated variable name like Account_1?
Đáp án A: It indicates the object is the first version.
Đáp án B: It indicates an error in the model.
Đáp án C: It is a temporary variable that will be deleted.
Đáp án D: Mendix automatically appends a number to avoid variable name collisions (shadowing) if a variable with the name Account already exists in the scope.
Đáp án E: It means the object is dirty (unsaved).
Đáp án F: It means it is a List.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: Mendix automatically appends a number to avoid variable name collisions (shadowing) if a variable with the name Account already exists in the scope..

Câu hỏi (Question): In a Microflow, what is the difference between 'Commit' and 'Commit without events'?
Đáp án A: 'Commit without events' creates a new version of the object.
Đáp án B: 'Commit' requires a user session; 'without events' does not.
Đáp án C: 'Commit' saves to the database; 'Commit without events' saves to memory only.
Đáp án D: 'Commit' triggers the Before/After Commit event handlers. 'Commit without events' saves the data but bypasses these event handlers.
Đáp án E: 'Commit' is synchronous; 'Commit without events' is asynchronous.
Đáp án F: 'Commit without events' does not update the 'ChangedDate' system attribute.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: 'Commit' triggers the Before/After Commit event handlers. 'Commit without events' saves the data but bypasses these event handlers..

Câu hỏi (Question): What is the purpose of the com.mendix.core.Core.execute(Context c, String microflowName, Map<String, Object> params) Java API method?
Đáp án A: It compiles the microflow into Java code.
Đáp án B: It creates a new user session.
Đáp án C: It executes a SQL query directly against the database.
Đáp án D: It allows you to execute a Microflow from within a custom Java Action.
Đáp án E: It sends a REST request to another Mendix app.
Đáp án F: It restarts the Mendix Runtime.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: It allows you to execute a Microflow from within a custom Java Action..

Câu hỏi (Question): What is the effect of the 'Store' property in a Mapping (Import Mapping) when set to 'No' (false) for a specific entity?
Đáp án A: It forces the use of a custom Java Action.
Đáp án B: The data for that entity is skipped and not mapped at all.
Đáp án C: It automatically creates a simplified 'DTO' object.
Đáp án D: The mapping throws an error if the data is present in the XML/JSON.
Đáp án E: The entity is deleted from the database.
Đáp án F: The entity is mapped to a transient object (Non-Persistable) or kept in memory, but Commit is not automatically called by the mapping.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (F): Đáp án chính xác là: The entity is mapped to a transient object (Non-Persistable) or kept in memory, but Commit is not automatically called by the mapping..

Câu hỏi (Question): What does the function reversed() do?
Đáp án A: It reverses the previous query so that you can execute it another time.
Đáp án B: It reverses the order of the returned list.
Đáp án C: It changes the direction in which the association is queried.
Đáp án D: It reverses the time used for the query.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: It changes the direction in which the association is queried..

Câu hỏi (Question): What does the following XPath query return? [OrderManagement.OrderLine_Product/OrderManagement.OrderLine/OrderMa nagement.OrderLine_Order != $Order]
Đáp án A: All the products that aren’t ordered at any order.
Đáp án B: All the products that aren’t ordered on the affected order.
Đáp án C: All the products that are ordered at least once, but not on the affected order
Đáp án D: All the products that are ordered at least once, including on the affected order.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: All the products that are ordered at least once, but not on the affected order.

Câu hỏi (Question): This XPath query can be optimized as follows:
Đáp án A: [OrderManagement.OrderLine_Product/OrderManagement.Product/MinimalStock > 50]
Đáp án B: [OrderManagement.OrderLine_Product/OrderManagement.Product/Status = 'Active']
Đáp án C: [OrderManagement.OrderLine_Product/OrderManagement.Product[MinimalStock > 50 or Status = 'Active']]
Đáp án D: [OrderManagement.OrderLine_Product/OrderManagement.Product[MinimalStock > 50] or [Status = 'Active']]
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: [OrderManagement.OrderLine_Product/OrderManagement.Product[MinimalStock > 50 or Status = 'Active']].

Câu hỏi (Question): The request as result of this XPath can be optimized as follows:
Đáp án A: [OrderManagement.Stock_Product/OrderManagement.Product/Status = 'Deactivated'
Đáp án B: or
Đáp án C: OrderManagement.Stock_Supplier/OrderManagement.Supplier/Active = false()]
Đáp án D: The request is automatically optimized by the database server.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: or.

Câu hỏi (Question): Which of the following statements is NOT an XPath best practice with regards to optimal performance?
Đáp án A: Limit the usage of the OR operator, as it can negatively impact performance.
Đáp án B: Limit the number of associations that are crossed when defining a constraint.
Đáp án C: When combining multiple constraints, start with the most constraining limit first.
Đáp án D: Do not use XPath when you can use SQL instead.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: Do not use XPath when you can use SQL instead..

Câu hỏi (Question): Consider a situation in which there is an entity called Request with an attribute status that has three values: Draft, Submitted, and Approved. There are three user roles: Administrator, Customer, and Employee. The Customer user role is granted the Customer module role. The only access rule configured is read/write access for the Customer with the XPath [Status = Draft] applied. What would a user with the Customer user role see on a page with a data grid without any additional XPath constraints?
Đáp án A: All the requests.
Đáp án B: All the results, but read-only access for non-draft requests.
Đáp án C: All the requests in the Draft status.
Đáp án D: No results would be returned.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: All the requests in the Draft status..

Câu hỏi (Question): Consider the exact same situation as above. What would Admin users see?
Đáp án A: All the requests.
Đáp án B: No results would be returned.
Đáp án C: All requests in the Draft status.
Đáp án D: All the results, but read-only for non-draft requests.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: No results would be returned..

Câu hỏi (Question): Consider the same situation again. What would happen if you granted Admin users access to a page with the Request entity in Studio Pro?
Đáp án A: Users would see no error message, but Security errors would appear in the logs.
Đáp án B: Admin users would see an error pop-up window when attempting to access the page.
Đáp án C: Studio Pro would detect an error and prevent a deployment.
Đáp án D: Admin users would be able to view the page.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: Studio Pro would detect an error and prevent a deployment..

Câu hỏi (Question): How does the platform use entity access XPaths to enforce security?
Đáp án A: The business server interprets the XPaths to prevent sensitive data from entering the system memory.
Đáp án B: The user's browser translates the XPaths to show or hide action buttons.
Đáp án C: The XPaths are added to all the relevant database retrieves.
Đáp án D: All of these answer options are correct.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: The XPaths are added to all the relevant database retrieves..

Câu hỏi (Question): Where are entity access restrictions applied?
Đáp án A: On every microflow.
Đáp án B: All of these answer options are correct.
Đáp án C: On every page.
Đáp án D: On relevant database retrieves.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: On relevant database retrieves..

Câu hỏi (Question): For the following questions, assume there is an app with three user roles: Administrator, Teacher, and Student.
Đáp án A: Administrators are granted the ability to manage all user roles, and Teachers can manage users with the Student role. Which of the following statements is false?
Đáp án B: Teachers and administrators are able to edit the details of student accounts.
Đáp án C: Administrators and teachers can create teacher accounts.
Đáp án D: Administrators are able to create other administrator accounts.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: Teachers and administrators are able to edit the details of student accounts..

Câu hỏi (Question): Let's say you want Teachers to be able to manage accounts for Students, but only the Students who are in their class. So, you grant Teachers the ability to manage users with the Student role in the app security menu. Will this be sufficient?
Đáp án A: No, because only Admins should have the ability to edit accounts.
Đáp án B: No, because teachers will have the ability to edit the accounts of any Student, not just their own.
Đáp án C: Yes, because Accounts are a specialization of the User entity.
Đáp án D: Yes, because now Teachers can edit the account details of the Students.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: Yes, because now Teachers can edit the account details of the Students..

Câu hỏi (Question): What is a benefit of assigning only one user role to each user?
Đáp án A: It requires users to create a new account if they need to change roles.
Đáp án B: It is inherently more secure.
Đáp án C: Simplicity.
Đáp án D: Better representation of business specific processes.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: Simplicity..

Chủ đề (Topic): Constrain Your Data Using Advanced XPath
Câu hỏi (Question): Which operation can be used to select a specific set of rows in a table?
Đáp án A: Projection
Đáp án B: Elimination
Đáp án C: Selection
Đáp án D: Set operation
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: Selection.

Chủ đề (Topic): Constrain Your Data Using Advanced XPath
Câu hỏi (Question): The Set Union operation combines two lists into one that contains:
Đáp án A: All elements that exist in both lists.
Đáp án B: All elements that appear in only one of the two lists.
Đáp án C: All elements from both lists.
Đáp án D: All elements from both lists without duplicates.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: All elements from both lists without duplicates..

Chủ đề (Topic): Constrain Your Data Using Advanced XPath
Câu hỏi (Question): What operation combines the data from two different entities into one table?
Đáp án A: Projection
Đáp án B: Set union
Đáp án C: Cartesian product
Đáp án D: Set difference
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: Cartesian product.

Chủ đề (Topic): Constrain Your Data Using Advanced XPath
Câu hỏi (Question): What does the Projection operation do?
Đáp án A: It allows you to project an entity onto a data view.
Đáp án B: It allows you to add two lists into one.
Đáp án C: It allows you to select attributes for all objects.
Đáp án D: It allows you to select objects from an entity.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: It allows you to select objects from an entity..

Chủ đề (Topic): Constrain Your Data Using Advanced XPath
Câu hỏi (Question): What can you use a constraint function for?
Đáp án A: To use Java in your XPath queries.
Đáp án B: To select objects based on enumerations.
Đáp án C: To call a microflow into your XPath.
Đáp án D: To filter on strings and dates in XPath queries.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: To call a microflow into your XPath..

Chủ đề (Topic): Constrain Your Data Using Advanced XPath
Câu hỏi (Question): Which of the queries below can be used to filter on dates two weeks in the past?
Đáp án A: [%BeginOfCurrentDay%] - 2 * [%WeekLength%]
Đáp án B: [%CurrentDay%] - 2 * [%WeekLength%]
Đáp án C: [%BeginOfCurrentDay%] - 2 + [%WeekLength%]
Đáp án D: [%CurrentDay%] - 2 + [%WeekLength%]
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: [%BeginOfCurrentDay%] - 2 * [%WeekLength%].

Chủ đề (Topic): Constrain Your Data Using Advanced XPath
Câu hỏi (Question): One of your XPath queries that use the contains() function is not performing very well. What is the most likely root cause?
Đáp án A: You are using the function on a string that is set to 'unlimited'.
Đáp án B: You are using the function on an attribute that is not a string.
Đáp án C: You have implemented a custom function in JavaScript.
Đáp án D: You have not implemented a separate XPath query for all the languages that your app is using.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: You have not implemented a separate XPath query for all the languages that your app is using..

Chủ đề (Topic): Constrain Your Data Using Advanced XPath
Câu hỏi (Question): When using the OR operator:
Đáp án A: ‘or’ must be the first word in the XPath expression.
Đáp án B: Simply place the word ‘or’ between two XPath statements.
Đáp án C: You can omit the word ‘or’ and instead enter two separate XPath statements, each with its own set of [].
Đáp án D: You must enclose the statement following the ‘or’ in ().
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: Simply place the word ‘or’ between two XPath statements..

Chủ đề (Topic): Constrain Your Data Using Advanced XPath
Câu hỏi (Question): The not() function:
Đáp án A: Generates the same query as the != operator.
Đáp án B: Generates a slow query.
Đáp án C: Can only be used on boolean attributes.
Đáp án D: Cannot be used when you use the OR operator.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: Generates a slow query..

Chủ đề (Topic): Constrain Your Data Using Advanced XPath
Câu hỏi (Question): Which statement best describes how you would retrieve all related objects in the most optimal way?
Đáp án A: When you use an object in your XPath, you need to compare it to an entity directly like this: [Sales.Customer_Account/Administration.Account = $currentUser] to get the most optimal query.
Đáp án B: You can only compare an object to the id attribute of an entity of the same type to get the most optimal query.
Đáp án C: Mendix will optimize your XPath expressions at runtime.
Đáp án D: When comparing to a related entity, it is enough to stop at the association to get the most optimal query.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: When comparing to a related entity, it is enough to stop at the association to get the most optimal query..

Chủ đề (Topic): Constrain Your Data Using Advanced XPath
Câu hỏi (Question): When should you apply an index?
Đáp án A: You should only apply indexes on boolean attributes.
Đáp án B: Mendix will apply indexes where needed, you don’t need to worry about that.
Đáp án C: You should always apply indexes on all your attributes; that makes your app faster.
Đáp án D: You should apply indexes on attributes that are used in searches when the performance of your app is not up to par.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: You should apply indexes on attributes that are used in searches when the performance of your app is not up to par..

Chủ đề (Topic): Constrain Your Data Using Advanced XPath
Câu hỏi (Question): What is normalization?
Đáp án A: The addition of entities to your domain model that help you track normal behavior of your app.
Đáp án B: The removal of duplicate data from your domain model.
Đáp án C: The addition of attributes to your entities to store data in multiple places to your app runs faster.
Đáp án D: The act of removing unneeded entities from your domain model.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: The removal of duplicate data from your domain model..

Chủ đề (Topic): Constrain Your Data Using Advanced XPath
Câu hỏi (Question): Why would you want to normalize your domain model?
Đáp án A: To make your domain model easier to read.
Đáp án B: To prepare your app for deployment on a cloud node.
Đáp án C: To remove duplicate data from your app so you can avoid insertion, update, and deletion anomalies.
Đáp án D: To increase the performance of your XPath retrieves.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: To remove duplicate data from your app so you can avoid insertion, update, and deletion anomalies..

Chủ đề (Topic): Constrain Your Data Using Advanced XPath
Câu hỏi (Question): What is denormalization?
Đáp án A: The removal of XPath expressions to increase performance.
Đáp án B: The addition of more entities in your domain model to increase performance.
Đáp án C: The addition of more associations to your domain model to increase performance.
Đáp án D: The duplication of information in several entities to increase performance.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: The duplication of information in several entities to increase performance..

Chủ đề (Topic): Design and Publish a REST API
Câu hỏi (Question): What does idempotent mean?
Đáp án A: That there is no restriction on what you can do with such a request
Đáp án B: That the effect of multiple identical requests is the same as a single such request
Đáp án C: That you can change all attribute values of the target object with such a request
Đáp án D: That the input of multiple identical requests can be the same as a single such request
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: That the effect of multiple identical requests is the same as a single such request.

Chủ đề (Topic): Design and Publish a REST API
Câu hỏi (Question): Which methods are considered safe?
Đáp án A: GET, HEAD & POST
Đáp án B: HEAD, PATCH & PUT
Đáp án C: GET, HEAD & OPTIONS
Đáp án D: POST, PATCH & PUT
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: GET, HEAD & OPTIONS.

Chủ đề (Topic): Design and Publish a REST API
Câu hỏi (Question): When retrieving resources based on a unique identifier, you should add the identifier as ...
Đáp án A: A path parameter
Đáp án B: A header
Đáp án C: A query
Đáp án D: Part of the message body
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: A path parameter.

Chủ đề (Topic): Design and Publish a REST API
Câu hỏi (Question): A 4xx response code means
Đáp án A: An error caused by the user
Đáp án B: There was an error on the server
Đáp án C: The message was not received
Đáp án D: Success
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: An error caused by the user.

Chủ đề (Topic): Design and Publish a REST API
Câu hỏi (Question): Failing to authenticate with a service will result in a
Đáp án A: 400 Bad Request
Đáp án B: 404 Not Found
Đáp án C: 401 Unauthorized
Đáp án D: 403 Forbidden
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: 401 Unauthorized.

Chủ đề (Topic): Design and Publish a REST API
Câu hỏi (Question): Requesting a single item (e.g. /books/1234) that does not exist will result in a
Đáp án A: 200 OK
Đáp án B: 204 No Content
Đáp án C: 404 Not Found
Đáp án D: 500 Internal Server Error
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: 404 Not Found.

Chủ đề (Topic): Design and Publish a REST API
Câu hỏi (Question): What information should not be returned when an error occurs on the server?
Đáp án A: User messages intended to be displayed to the user
Đáp án B: The stacktrace
Đáp án C: Technical information intended for developers
Đáp án D: List of errors
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: The stacktrace.

Chủ đề (Topic): Design and Publish a REST API
Câu hỏi (Question): Which of the following places can you add documentation?
Đáp án A: Method
Đáp án B: Status Code
Đáp án C: Authentication
Đáp án D: Parameters
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: Parameters.

Chủ đề (Topic): Design and Publish a REST API
Câu hỏi (Question): What is a downside of using JSON definitions?
Đáp án A: Examples will always be values such as "string" and 0
Đáp án B: There will be no examples on the swagger page
Đáp án C: You need to add the examples yourself
Đáp án D: Examples are generated from your json snippet
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: There will be no examples on the swagger page.

Chủ đề (Topic): Design and Publish a REST API
Câu hỏi (Question): The model on the swagger page will be based on
Đáp án A: Input parameters
Đáp án B: Operations
Đáp án C: Export and import mapping
Đáp án D: Documentation
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: Export and import mapping.

Chủ đề (Topic): Design and Publish a REST API
Câu hỏi (Question): Besides JSON mapping, mapping documents for a rest service can be created by using a..
Đáp án A: Swagger file
Đáp án B: Microflow
Đáp án C: Message definition
Đáp án D: WSDL
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: Message definition.

Chủ đề (Topic): Design and Publish a REST API
Câu hỏi (Question): Which authentication method is not a selectable option?
Đáp án A: Active session
Đáp án B: Custom
Đáp án C: Username and password
Đáp án D: API Key
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: API Key.

Chủ đề (Topic): Design and Publish a REST API
Câu hỏi (Question): What does a custom authentication microflow return?
Đáp án A: Nothing
Đáp án B: Boolean
Đáp án C: httpResponse Object
Đáp án D: User
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: User.

Chủ đề (Topic): Design and Publish a REST API
Câu hỏi (Question): Which authentication type is used as default?
Đáp án A: API Key
Đáp án B: OAuth client grant
Đáp án C: Basic Auth
Đáp án D: Bearer Token (JWT)
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: Basic Auth.

Chủ đề (Topic): Design and Publish a REST API
Câu hỏi (Question): What type of documentation is automatically generated?
Đáp án A: Message definition
Đáp án B: Swagger json
Đáp án C: WSDL
Đáp án D: Postman Collection
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: Swagger json.

Câu hỏi (Question): Which of the following is a field of a Mendix log message?
Đáp án A: Log line
Đáp án B: Log content
Đáp án C: Log event
Đáp án D: Log node
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: Log node.

Câu hỏi (Question): Where can you see the log messages for your app?
Đáp án A: In the debugger
Đáp án B: In the error pane
Đáp án C: In the console
Đáp án D: In the connector
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: In the console.

Câu hỏi (Question): What is the difference between log messages in Studio Pro and log messages in the Mendix portal?
Đáp án A: The log messages in the Mendix Portal have a Source field.
Đáp án B: The log messages in the Mendix Portal have a Destination field.
Đáp án C: The log messages in the Mendix Portal have a Cloud field.
Đáp án D: The log messages in the Mendix Portal have a Web field.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: The log messages in the Mendix Portal have a Source field..

Câu hỏi (Question): Where do log messages come from?
Đáp án A: The developers at Mendix write all log messages you will encounter in a Mendix application.
Đáp án B: Mendix Assist generates the log messages for all Mendix applications.
Đáp án C: They are written by the IEEE log commission to ensure log messages conform to standards.
Đáp án D: Log messages are written by the person who created the functionality.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: Log messages are written by the person who created the functionality..

Câu hỏi (Question): When the log level is set to Error, messages from which other log level will also show up in your logs?
Đáp án A: Debug
Đáp án B: Warning
Đáp án C: Critical
Đáp án D: All log levels
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: Critical.

Câu hỏi (Question): Which log level is used to warn about unexpected behavior that doesn’t need immediate action?
Đáp án A: Warning
Đáp án B: Debug
Đáp án C: Info
Đáp án D: Error
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: Warning.

Câu hỏi (Question): Which statement about log nodes is true?
Đáp án A: Log nodes are dynamically registered on application startup.
Đáp án B: Mendix has a list of predefined log nodes. No other nodes can be defined.
Đáp án C: Log nodes are added through the Set Log Level screen in Studio Pro.
Đáp án D: Log nodes are defined in the Mendix portal.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: Log nodes are dynamically registered on application startup..

Câu hỏi (Question): Which of the following statements about log levels is true?
Đáp án A: Messages at the Debug level signal a big problem with your application.
Đáp án B: Messages at the Warning level need to be resolved immediately.
Đáp án C: Messages at the Trace level need your immediate attention.
Đáp án D: Messages at the Info level occur during normal operation of your app.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: Messages at the Info level occur during normal operation of your app..

Câu hỏi (Question): Who is responsible for writing the error messages that your application generates?
Đáp án A: The project manager.
Đáp án B: The user.
Đáp án C: The developer.
Đáp án D: Logs are generated automatically.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: The developer..

Câu hỏi (Question): Which description best describes a Stack Trace?
Đáp án A: A series of log messages at the log level Trace that are related.
Đáp án B: A list of functions that were being called when an error occurred.
Đáp án C: A list of objects that were in memory at the time the error occurred.
Đáp án D: A list of functions that might have the same problem as the error you’re experiencing.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: A list of functions that were being called when an error occurred..

Câu hỏi (Question): Why should you use an enumeration for your log node names?
Đáp án A: You should not, constants are the preferred for log node names.
Đáp án B: Log events only accept enumerations as input for the log node names.
Đáp án C: This allows you to standardize the log node name and group all log node names in your app.
Đáp án D: You should not, log node names should use a special entity to get their names.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: This allows you to standardize the log node name and group all log node names in your app..

Câu hỏi (Question): How do you ensure that your log node name is available after startup?
Đáp án A: Add it to the list of log nodes in Studio Pro.
Đáp án B: All log nodes in your app are added to the list automatically upon startup.
Đáp án C: You can’t, you will have to wait until one of your log activities is reached before you can see the log event.
Đáp án D: Add a log activity to a microflow that you call in the After Startup microflow.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: Add a log activity to a microflow that you call in the After Startup microflow..

Câu hỏi (Question): You want to add a log event to an error flow on your REST Call to indicate a weather API call failed in your Holiday Request application. Which level of logging should you use?
Đáp án A: Critical, you’re unable to request vacation if you do not know the weather at your destination.
Đáp án B: Warning, you can still continue but someone should look into why the REST call is failing and whether further action is needed.
Đáp án C: Info, this is part of the normal operation of your app, these things happen, nothing to see here.
Đáp án D: Error, if the weather is unavailable you can still request vacation but someone should immediately investigate.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: Warning, you can still continue but someone should look into why the REST call is failing and whether further action is needed..

Câu hỏi (Question): True or false: by association will always be an in-memory retrieve.
Đáp án A: True, associated objects are always available in memory, therefore it is always an in-memory retrieve.
Đáp án B: False, if objects aren’t available in memory, a retrieve by association will automatically result in a database retrieve.
Đáp án C: True, technically, a retrieve by association cannot result in a query on the database.
Đáp án D: False, a retrieve by association will always retrieve the objects from the database directly, to maintain data consistency.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: False, if objects aren’t available in memory, a retrieve by association will automatically result in a database retrieve..

Câu hỏi (Question): Which of the following best describes how the Mendix platform applies entity access?
Đáp án A: The platform assumes access is granted until it is explicitly removed.
Đáp án B: The platform grants read/write access to all Admin users.
Đáp án C: The platform grants read access to all attributes, but write access must be explicitly specified.
Đáp án D: The platform only grants the access explicitly defined in the entity access rules.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: The platform only grants the access explicitly defined in the entity access rules..

Câu hỏi (Question): Referring to the same domain model as was used in question #2, if we create a page with a data grid containing Houses and autogenerate a House_NewEdit page, which of the following statements is FALSE for an Admin user?
Đáp án A: Admin users will not see the SquareFoot attribute in the Edit page.
Đáp án B: Admin users will be able to edit the SquareFoot attribute.
Đáp án C: Admin users will not be able to create new Houses or delete existing Houses using the default buttons in the control bar of the data grid.
Đáp án D: Admin users will be able to read the SquareFoot attribute.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: Admin users will not see the SquareFoot attribute in the Edit page..

Câu hỏi (Question): Why is it more secure to add security rules on the entity level?
Đáp án A: Entity level restrictions are applied at the database level and are thus automatically applied throughout the application.
Đáp án B: Entity level security secures each entity throughout the application.
Đáp án C: Entity level restrictions affect what the end-users will see.
Đáp án D: Users will not see entities to which they have no access.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: Entity level restrictions are applied at the database level and are thus automatically applied throughout the application..

Câu hỏi (Question): Which of the following is a valid Mendix token?
Đáp án A: CurrentAccount
Đáp án B: CurrentUser
Đáp án C: CurrentTime
Đáp án D: CurrentDate
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: CurrentUser.

Câu hỏi (Question): You are creating a microflow where you have a Change Object activity. The change is dependent on a lot of checks and decisions (but, whichever choice, the change always happens). What is the best way to model this microflow?
Đáp án A: Use an if-then-else statement directly in the Change Object activity to set the correct value.
Đáp án B: Use Decisions, but place them in a sub -microflow to determine what the new value should be, and then use the return value of tha t sub-microflow in the Change Object activity.
Đáp án C: For each check, place a Decision in the microflow so that each step is visible and easy to read.
Đáp án D: Create a new variable in which you use an if-then-else statement to determine the correct value and use the variable in the Change Object activity.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: Use Decisions, but place them in a sub -microflow to determine what the new value should be, and then use the return value of tha t sub-microflow in the Change Object activity..

Câu hỏi (Question): You need to determine what day of the week it is. What is the easiest way to do this?
Đáp án A: It is not possible to do this.
Đáp án B: Use the formatDateTime function.
Đáp án C: Use the BeginOfCurrentWeek and BeginOfCurrentDay tokens in combination with the daysBetween function and an if-then-else statement.
Đáp án D: Use the token CurrentDayOfWeek.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: Use the formatDateTime function..

Câu hỏi (Question): What is the best approach to retrieve an object over association, while also checking whether the association exists?
Đáp án A: Use a business rule to check whether the association exists. If it does, retrieve the associated object and return it to the microflow.
Đáp án B: Use a decision to first check whether the association exists. If it does, retrieve the associated object.
Đáp án C: Use an if-then-else statement to only retrieve the object if the association exists.
Đáp án D: First retrieve the object and then use a decision to check whether the object is empty or not.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: Use a decision to first check whether the association exists. If it does, retrieve the associated object..

Câu hỏi (Question): Which of the following statements about lists is true?
Đáp án A: A list can have, among others, the following origins: a retrieve action, the creation of a new list, and the result of an input parameter.
Đáp án B: Before looping through a list, you have to check that it isn’t empty.
Đáp án C: If you want to empty a list, you have to remove the objects in the list one by one.
Đáp án D: A list can contain different types of objects.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: A list can have, among others, the following origins: a retrieve action, the creation of a new list, and the result of an input parameter..

Câu hỏi (Question): You have to determine how many customers are in the database and you already know that there are a few thousand. What is the best way to handle this?
Đáp án A: Retrieve the customers in batches of 100 and loop through them to count them all. In this way, you ensure that you don’t over load the system with too much data
Đáp án B: Store the number of customers in the database, and update every time you add or delete a customer.
Đáp án C: Retrieve all the customers at once and loop through them to count them all.
Đáp án D: Retrieve all the customers at once and use an aggregate list activity to count them. Because this is an optimized query on th e database, it will be very light and safe to use, even for big lists.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: Retrieve all the customers at once and use an aggregate list activity to count them. Because this is an optimized query on th e database, it will be very light and safe to use, even for big lists..

Câu hỏi (Question): What does the List Operation tail do?
Đáp án A: It grabs the last element in the list.
Đáp án B: It grabs all elements in the list except the first element.
Đáp án C: It sorts the list in descending order with the last item first.
Đáp án D: It creates a log that tracks all changes to the list.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: It grabs all elements in the list except the first element..

Câu hỏi (Question): When would you typically use a List Operation?
Đáp án A: When you are working with objects that only exist in memory.
Đáp án B: All of these answers are correct.
Đáp án C: When creating report data to view in chart widgets.
Đáp án D: To avoid complex XPaths.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: All of these answers are correct..

Câu hỏi (Question): Creating a user account in an app is a form of
