Đáp án A: Provisioning
Đáp án B: Authentication
Đáp án C: Identification
Đáp án D: Authorization
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: Provisioning.

Câu hỏi (Question): A protocol used for user provisioning is
Đáp án A: OAuth
Đáp án B: OpenID
Đáp án C: SAML
Đáp án D: LDAP
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: LDAP.

Câu hỏi (Question): Where can you give a user permission to deploy to a cloud environment in the cloud portal?
Đáp án A: The configuration page of an environment
Đáp án B: The “Permissions” section of a project
Đáp án C: The user’s profile page
Đáp án D: The “Deployment” section of a project
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: The “Permissions” section of a project.

Câu hỏi (Question): Which rights will allow a user to read log files for a cloud environment?
Đáp án A: Access backups
Đáp án B: Receive alerts
Đáp án C: Access monitoring
Đáp án D: Transport
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: Access monitoring.

Câu hỏi (Question): Who can edit the security settings for a cloud code?
Đáp án A: The development team
Đáp án B: The technical contact
Đáp án C: The product owner
Đáp án D: The SCRUM master
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: The technical contact.

Câu hỏi (Question): Access Restriction Profiles allow you to limit access to your app to
Đáp án A: Users with a certain role
Đáp án B: Users with two-factor authentication
Đáp án C: Mobile or desktop devices
Đáp án D: IP addresses in a certain range
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: IP addresses in a certain range.

Câu hỏi (Question): SSL client certificate authentication means that when a Mendix app calls a service
Đáp án A: The app will present a certificate to the service
Đáp án B: The service will present a certificate to the user
Đáp án C: The service will present a certificate to the app
Đáp án D: The user will present a certificate to the app
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: The app will present a certificate to the service.

Câu hỏi (Question): You can configure client certificates to use when calling web services from a cloud environment in the
Đáp án A: Project settings in the modeler
Đáp án B: Environment settings in the cloud portal
Đáp án C: Security settings in the cloud portal
Đáp án D: Security settings in the modeler
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: Environment settings in the cloud portal.

Câu hỏi (Question): Configuring SSL client certificate authentication for published services can be done through
Đáp án A: Project settings
Đáp án B: Microflows
Đáp án C: Access restriction profiles
Đáp án D: Request handlers
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: Access restriction profiles.

Câu hỏi (Question): What are the two export levels?
Đáp án A: Hidden & Usable
Đáp án B: Protected & Open
Đáp án C: Consumer & Source
Đáp án D: Exportable & Internal
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: Hidden & Usable.

Câu hỏi (Question): Which of these features makes sure we can now also build adaptable solutions with the Mendix platform?
Đáp án A: App modules
Đáp án B: Implementation hiding
Đáp án C: Source mode
Đáp án D: Solution modules
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: Solution modules.

Câu hỏi (Question): When you use the export level “hidden” to hide entities, attributes, etcetera, which of the following will be affected?
Đáp án A: Using Mx Model reflection module
Đáp án B: Run time
Đáp án C: Design time
Đáp án D: Database
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: Design time.

Câu hỏi (Question): If you have a solution module containing a single microflow with export level set to ‘usable’, how can your customers use it?
Đáp án A: They can change the input and output
Đáp án B: They can add actions to the microflow
Đáp án C: They cannot use it
Đáp án D: They can use the microflow in their own customizations
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: They can use the microflow in their own customizations.

Câu hỏi (Question): When you have defined a page and placed it in a protected module, what action do you need to perform if you want the consuming side to use it, but not to make alterations to it?
Đáp án A: You don’t need to perform any actions, because a page in a protected module can never be used by the consuming side
Đáp án B: You need to create a flow usable for the consuming side that opens the page
Đáp án C: You need to duplicate the page and place the duplication in an implementation module
Đáp án D: You don’t need to perform any actions, the page is usable by the consuming side
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: You need to create a flow usable for the consuming side that opens the page.

Câu hỏi (Question): If you want to export (a new version of) your solution which package type do you select?
Đáp án A: Solution package
Đáp án B: Module package
Đáp án C: Project package
Đáp án D: Source package
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: Solution package.

Câu hỏi (Question): If you have multiple customers for your solution, why is a shared Team Server repository not recommended?
Đáp án A: It will be unclear what work is done for which customer
Đáp án B: If you have a shared Team Server repository there are access and IP protection problems
Đáp án C: Having a shared Team Server repository will cause performance issues
Đáp án D: Customers will be able to access each others data since they share the same repository
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: If you have a shared Team Server repository there are access and IP protection problems.

Câu hỏi (Question): When allowing for extensions on your core domain models in your adaptable solution, there are two ways to facilitate: inheritance and association (1-1 or 1-n). What is the upside of choosing an association between your core entity and its extension counterpart?
Đáp án A: An entity in an app module cannot inherit from an entity in a solution module.
Đáp án B: It is more secure than other options.
Đáp án C: It is easy to implement because only some basic additional logic is needed.
Đáp án D: Customers can create their own extension points for entities.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: It is easy to implement because only some basic additional logic is needed..

Câu hỏi (Question): What is the goal of an extension flow?
Đáp án A: To enable customers to change your core logic
Đáp án B: To provide your customer with changeable, predefined logic
Đáp án C: To make sure that extension objects are saved correctly together with the owning entity.
Đáp án D: To enable customers to add custom logic on top of your protected core logic
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: To enable customers to add custom logic on top of your protected core logic.

Câu hỏi (Question): When you allow extensions or adaptations of your solution, you’ll want to make use of implementation modules (followed by the suffix ‘_Impl’). Why is this?
Đáp án A: Separation of Concerns. The goals of your core logic and any extensions or adaptations are different and should therefore be separated into different modules.
Đáp án B: You will want to clearly differentiate between what you as vendor add to the solution and any customizations. This is more difficult when both are done in the same module
Đáp án C: Using a different module for this and giving it the suffix ‘_Impl’ clearly distinguishes it from core modules, improving main tainability
Đáp án D: Your customers/implementation partners should be able to make changes to this module and this cannot be done in a protected module
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: Your customers/implementation partners should be able to make changes to this module and this cannot be done in a protected module.

Câu hỏi (Question): What is the difference between the expand scenario versus the extend and adapt scenarios?
Đáp án A: In the expand scenario you built custom apps to overwrite your core modules.
Đáp án B: In the expand scenario you extend your solution by adding other Mendix applications or solutions on top.
Đáp án C: In the expand scenario you use Mendix Connect to expose your solutions data.
Đáp án D: In the expand scenario you only extend outside of your solution but not within.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: In the expand scenario you extend your solution by adding other Mendix applications or solutions on top..

Câu hỏi (Question): How can Mendix Connect help you expand your solution?
Đáp án A: With Mendix Connect you can very easily expose entities to other Mendix applications.
Đáp án B: With Mendix Connect you don’t need extension points in your domain models anymore.
Đáp án C: With Mendix Connect, Mendix automatically creates endpoints for you.
Đáp án D: Updating will be easier since all customizations can be done in apps that communicate with the core using Mendix Connect.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: With Mendix Connect you can very easily expose entities to other Mendix applications..

Câu hỏi (Question): What is a big plus of the Expand scenario?
Đáp án A: It will help you sell more apps, because you can sell these as add-ons providing more functionalities.
Đáp án B: It will help you better and more permanently position your solution within a customers app landscape.
Đáp án C: Because you can easily expand your solution with more apps you can build your solution faster, since the core will be smaller.
Đáp án D: It will make it easier to build a prescriptive multi-tenant SaaS solution.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: It will help you better and more permanently position your solution within a customers app landscape..

Câu hỏi (Question): What is an adaptable solution?
Đáp án A: An application where anything can easily be changed through Mendix Studio Pro.
Đáp án B: An add-on for COTS software.
Đáp án C: An application that consists of a common core, and room for flexibility in the form a customizations on top of it.
Đáp án D: An application that receives continuous automatic updates.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: An application that consists of a common core, and room for flexibility in the form a customizations on top of it..

Câu hỏi (Question): What is a benefit of an adaptable solution?
Đáp án A: There is no need to work with Mendix Studio Pro.
Đáp án B: Every functionality of an application has been set in stone.
Đáp án C: It can be customized to an implementation team’s needs, while also retaining future upgradeability of the common core.
Đáp án D: It’s the least complex type of application to develop.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: It can be customized to an implementation team’s needs, while also retaining future upgradeability of the common core..

Câu hỏi (Question): Why should you carefully consider your approach and development mindset when working with adaptable solutions?
Đáp án A: Because it’s important to realize the complexity involved in properly designing applications that have an immutable common co re, while also providing ways for implementation teams to add customizations to them .
Đáp án B: Because many existing processes of traditional application development are irrelevant.
Đáp án C: Because it’s completely different from any other type of application development.
Đáp án D: Because it’s much easier to implement than you’d think.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: Because it’s important to realize the complexity involved in properly designing applications that have an immutable common co re, while also providing ways for implementation teams to add customizations to them ..

Chủ đề (Topic): Manage Mendix Runtime and DB Interaction
Câu hỏi (Question): By default, Mendix object IDs are assembled by
Đáp án A: The Mendix Runtime, using only a sequential number generator.
Đáp án B: The database, using only a sequential number generator.
Đáp án C: The Mendix Runtime, using a sequential number generator combined with an entity ID.
Đáp án D: The database, using a sequential number generator combined with an entity ID.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: The Mendix Runtime, using a sequential number generator combined with an entity ID..

Chủ đề (Topic): Manage Mendix Runtime and DB Interaction
Câu hỏi (Question): If inheritance is applied, the table of a specialization will contain
Đáp án A: All attributes of the specialization and generalization
Đáp án B: Only the attributes of the specialization.
Đáp án C: All attributes and associations of the specialization and generalization.
Đáp án D: Only the attributes and associations of the specialization.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: Only the attributes of the specialization..

Chủ đề (Topic): Manage Mendix Runtime and DB Interaction
Câu hỏi (Question): During execution of a transaction, an error occurs, and the transaction can’t proceed. Which transaction characteristic ensures the transaction doesn't leave a partial state in the database?
Đáp án A: Durability
Đáp án B: Isolation
Đáp án C: Consistency
Đáp án D: Atomicity
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: Atomicity.

Chủ đề (Topic): Manage Mendix Runtime and DB Interaction
Câu hỏi (Question): Which transaction characteristic ensures that no duplicate entries can exist if an attribute is marked as unique in the model?
Đáp án A: Atomicity
Đáp án B: Isolation
Đáp án C: Consistency
Đáp án D: Durability
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: Consistency.

Chủ đề (Topic): Manage Mendix Runtime and DB Interaction
Câu hỏi (Question): Within my data grid, I can’t see objects which are currently being imported by a background process. Which transaction characteristic is being applied?
Đáp án A: Consistency
Đáp án B: Durability
Đáp án C: Isolation
Đáp án D: Atomicity
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: Isolation.

Chủ đề (Topic): Manage Mendix Runtime and DB Interaction
Câu hỏi (Question): When parts of a transaction should succeed or fail, what should be applied?
Đáp án A: Save points
Đáp án B: Milestones
Đáp án C: Commits
Đáp án D: Rollbacks
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: Save points.

Chủ đề (Topic): Manage Mendix Runtime and DB Interaction
Câu hỏi (Question): I want an import to either succeed or fail as a whole but send an administrator an email in case an error occurred. Which error handling should be applied?
Đáp án A: Continue
Đáp án B: Custom without rollback
Đáp án C: Rollback
Đáp án D: Custom with rollback
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: Custom with rollback.

Câu hỏi (Question): When you add a styling (UI resource) module, will this replace the main styling module?
Đáp án A: Yes, but only the Atlas_core styling. Everything in other styling modules or in your <projectname>/theme folder will coexist next to each other.
Đáp án B: Yes, a styling module will replace the styling in your <projectname>/theme folder and if you have more than one module, all the modules will add to the styling.
Đáp án C: No, it will be added to the styling that is already in the project.
Đáp án D: Yes, a styling module will replace the styling in your <projectname>/theme. folder and the module that is set as most dominan t will contain the styling of your application.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: No, it will be added to the styling that is already in the project..

Câu hỏi (Question): Why should you change the way Mendix imports your theming modules and the way it loads the variables?
Đáp án A: Because Mendix doesn’t support a custom theme out of the box.
Đáp án B: So you only have to change the variables you need to change per theming module, and keep your customization clean.
Đáp án C: To make sure that Mendix supports your custom classes in every module.
Đáp án D: This is only needed for solutions; every other way of building applications does support multiple theming files.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: So you only have to change the variables you need to change per theming module, and keep your customization clean..

Câu hỏi (Question): Why do you need to use “_” underscores in your SCSS filenames?
Đáp án A: So the developer knows what files are compiled and what files aren’t compiled.
Đáp án B: So Mendix knows which file has the most custom classes.
Đáp án C: The underscore makes it so that the compiler knows not to compile that SCSS file into a CSS file.
Đáp án D: For maintainability. An underscore indicates a custom file. Without an underscore is a Mendix Atlas styling file.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: The underscore makes it so that the compiler knows not to compile that SCSS file into a CSS file..

Câu hỏi (Question): Why do you place files into so many different folders?
Đáp án A: For better maintainability at the cost of longer load times.
Đáp án B: When you have many files, putting them in the right folders makes file or class searching much easier.
Đáp án C: When committing the project, the chance of conflicts is reduced.
Đáp án D: Otherwise the SASS compiler can‘t compile that many files at once.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: When you have many files, putting them in the right folders makes file or class searching much easier..

Câu hỏi (Question): What is needed to release a new version of a solution to the solution's end- users?
Đáp án A: Upon publishing the new version of the solution every consuming party will automatically get the latest version of the solution modules.
Đáp án B: All consuming parties will run the same application model and they only have to choose when to deploy the new version.
Đáp án C: A solution can only have one version and upgrading to a newer version is not possible.
Đáp án D: The ISV or enterprise needs to publish the new version of the solution core and an implementation team releases this
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: The ISV or enterprise needs to publish the new version of the solution core and an implementation team releases this.

Câu hỏi (Question): How can new features become part of a new version of the solution core?
Đáp án A: Consumers of the solution provide the product manager with feedback during regular feedback sessions
Đáp án B: The product manager of the ISV or enterprise creates a vision that drives the roadmap
Đáp án C: All answers are right
Đáp án D: Features can be harvested from solution implementations when common customizations are identified
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: All answers are right.

Câu hỏi (Question): What statement is correct concerning the solution core?
Đáp án A: All consuming parties will always run on the same version of the solution core
Đáp án B: Once something is added to the solution core and released to a customer or specific unit, it can no longer be removed
Đáp án C: The solution's development team can remove anything without notice from the solution core as long as it won’t lead to data loss for customers
Đáp án D: The modules of the solution core have explicit APIs for which the solution's development team should have a lifecycle that includes deprecation
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: The modules of the solution core have explicit APIs for which the solution's development team should have a lifecycle that includes deprecation.

Câu hỏi (Question): Who is responsible for upgrading the solution to the latest version of the Mendix platform?
Đáp án A: The implementation team determines what version of the Mendix platform they want to utilize.
Đáp án B: The implementation team can upgrade the solution at any time.
Đáp án C: Mendix determines what versions of the Mendix platform should be used for a solution.
Đáp án D: The ISV or enterprise decides what version of the Mendix Platform is used and updates of the solution core, the implementatio n team will update the extensions & customizations.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: The ISV or enterprise decides what version of the Mendix Platform is used and updates of the solution core, the implementatio n team will update the extensions & customizations..

Câu hỏi (Question): Which of the following statements about Support Strategy are true?
Đáp án A: An ISV or enterprise can determine their support lifecycle based on any version of the Mendix Platform and does not have to t ake the MTS and LTS cycle into account
Đáp án B: The implementation team is responsible for applying the patches released by Mendix to their solution
Đáp án C: You can only build an Adaptable Solution with MTS releases
Đáp án D: None of the statements are true
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: None of the statements are true.

Câu hỏi (Question): Who is responsible for community-supported content in a solution?
Đáp án A: The original uploader of the content will take on responsibility for support
Đáp án B: Mendix is responsible for any public Marketplace content
Đáp án C: A solution should never contain community supported content
Đáp án D: The ISV or enterprise takes on the responsibility of the community supported content, possibly supported by the original uplo ader of the supported content
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: The ISV or enterprise takes on the responsibility of the community supported content, possibly supported by the original uplo ader of the supported content.

Câu hỏi (Question): How do you check for known vulnerabilities for external dependencies?
Đáp án A: By filing a ticket with Mendix Support and receiving pro-active security emails
Đáp án B: By checking the Mendix and Siemens security bulletins list
Đáp án C: By asking the Marketplace publisher of the external dependencies and receiving pro-active security emails
Đáp án D: By searching the CVE library or leveraging a tool like Sigrid, Omnext, Snyk or XRay
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: By searching the CVE library or leveraging a tool like Sigrid, Omnext, Snyk or XRay.

Chủ đề (Topic): Design the UX/UI of Your Adaptable Solution
Câu hỏi (Question): When is the Way-of-Working workshop organized?
Đáp án A: Your team is not performing as well as the other teams in your organisation.
Đáp án B: If you want to gain insight into how a (potential) customer is working and if the workflow of your solution fits that customer, and/or so you can decide, after a few of these workshops, what the core functionality of the solution should be and where the customer can customize a bit in the workflow of the application.
Đáp án C: You want to explain to the customer how they should work with your solution and find the pain points so the customer can start adapting their work process to the new solution.
Đáp án D: Your team needs to understand who in the team is responsible for what part of the development process.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: If you want to gain insight into how a (potential) customer is working and if the workflow of your solution fits that customer, and/or so you can decide, after a few of these workshops, what the core functionality of the solution should be and where the customer can customize a bit in the workflow of the application..

Chủ đề (Topic): Design the UX/UI of Your Adaptable Solution
Câu hỏi (Question): Why should you use a minimal amount of custom classes and styling in your solution?
Đáp án A: It doesn’t matter at all.
Đáp án B: Your custom classes and styling needed to be loaded in, and this causes longer loading times per page.
Đáp án C: Custom classes and custom styling need to be exported and imported for every different customer to keep it working. This is, of course, a lot of work and thus should be avoided.
Đáp án D: With a lot of custom classes and custom styling, your customer is going to have a hard time applying their own custom styling to your solution, and therefore it makes the solution less attractive for them.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: With a lot of custom classes and custom styling, your customer is going to have a hard time applying their own custom styling to your solution, and therefore it makes the solution less attractive for them..

Chủ đề (Topic): Design the UX/UI of Your Adaptable Solution
Câu hỏi (Question): A layout-grid should be used for:
Đáp án A: Dividing content into columns and rows, aligning content vertically, and making your layout responsive.
Đáp án B: Only dividing content into columns to distribute content horizontally.
Đáp án C: Creating responsive vertical forms.
Đáp án D: Making responsive tables.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: Dividing content into columns and rows, aligning content vertically, and making your layout responsive..

Chủ đề (Topic): Design the UX/UI of Your Adaptable Solution
Câu hỏi (Question): Where should you restrict data access for a user to apply pluggable design principles?
Đáp án A: On the domain model and on the pages that use xpath as data source.
Đáp án B: Only on pages that you show to all users and not to specific user groups.
Đáp án C: On the domain model using entity access.
Đáp án D: On the page if it is shown to the user, and the entities that do not show up on a page using entity access in the domain model.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: On the domain model using entity access..

Chủ đề (Topic): Design the UX/UI of Your Adaptable Solution
Câu hỏi (Question): What are the best practices for working with entangled data?
Đáp án A: Only commit at the end, keep the objects in memory as long as you can and only commit at the end.
Đáp án B: Always commit directly when you change an attribute, this can be done in on change microflows if needed.
Đáp án C: Commit on the save button of the page, split up the pages and do not have nested pages with multiple save and cancel buttons.
Đáp án D: It depends on the page, sometimes you commit directly, sometimes only at the end when the user has entered all the data. Use isNew checks to see if the data was not auto-committed and have regular rollbacks if needed.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: Commit on the save button of the page, split up the pages and do not have nested pages with multiple save and cancel buttons..

Chủ đề (Topic): Design the UX/UI of Your Adaptable Solution
Câu hỏi (Question): How should you design your domain model?
Đáp án A: Design your domain model beforehand as per specs of the business case. Then if you need to add more attributes, use generalization and place the new attributes on this newly created object to add attributes, this way you can easily track the changes that were not on the original design.
Đáp án B: Decide before hand how your domain model should look like, then as you build add attributes as you need and where they are located on the page.
Đáp án C: First design you page, then see how you can design your domain model to reflect this and make developing a lot easier.
Đáp án D: Try to stay as close as you can to real life, normalize the data as much as you can and try not to let page layout determine your domain model.
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: Try to stay as close as you can to real life, normalize the data as much as you can and try not to let page layout determine your domain model..

Câu hỏi (Question): Permissions dealing with data access are called:
Đáp án A: Module roles
Đáp án B: Access roles
Đáp án C: Add-on roles
Đáp án D: Core roles
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: Core roles.

Câu hỏi (Question): Why would you want to use add-on roles?
Đáp án A: To model separate permissions without additional data access
Đáp án B: To model non-core functionality of the application
Đáp án C: To model separate permissions with additional data access
Đáp án D: To model more granular permissions
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (A): Đáp án chính xác là: To model separate permissions without additional data access.

Câu hỏi (Question): In the ticketing solution, you are asked to implement customers who will be managed by managers. What kind of role should you create to give permission to manage your customers?
Đáp án A: Add-on role: customers are not central to the application
Đáp án B: Add-on role: it’s an additional permission for managers
Đáp án C: Core role: customers are central to the application
Đáp án D: Core role: this role is concerned with data access
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (D): Đáp án chính xác là: Core role: this role is concerned with data access.

Câu hỏi (Question): Your client wants a user role for back office employees which can create tickets, edit their assigned tickets, and view all tickets of their group. How would you configure this?
Đáp án A: AddOn_TicketCreator, TicketEditMy, TicketViewMy, TicketViewGroup
Đáp án B: AddOn_TicketCreator, TicketEditMy, TicketViewGroup
Đáp án C: AddOn_TicketCreator, TicketEditMy, TicketViewGroup, GroupViewer
Đáp án D: AddOn_TicketCreator, TicketEditMy, TicketViewMy, TicketViewGroup, GroupViewer
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: AddOn_TicketCreator, TicketEditMy, TicketViewGroup, GroupViewer.

Câu hỏi (Question): Your client wants a user role for managers which can view and approve all tickets. How would you configure this?
Đáp án A: AddOn_TicketApprover, TicketViewAll, GroupManager
Đáp án B: TicketEditAll, GroupManager
Đáp án C: AddOn_TicketApprover, TicketViewAll, GroupViewer
Đáp án D: TicketEditAll, GroupViewer
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: AddOn_TicketApprover, TicketViewAll, GroupViewer.

Câu hỏi (Question): If a Scrum team gets stuck, because of things that are out of their control, who is responsible for removing those impediments?
Đáp án A: The Project Manager
Đáp án B: The Scrum Master
Đáp án C: The Product Owner
Đáp án D: The Development Team
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (B): Đáp án chính xác là: The Scrum Master.

Câu hỏi (Question): A critical success factor for companies working with Mendix is:
Đáp án A: Implementing the waterfall project management approach
Đáp án B: Working individually on projects depending on expertise
Đáp án C: Working in small cross-functional teams
Đáp án D: Knowing object- oriented programming
Giải thích chi tiết (Explanation): Giải thích (C): Đáp án chính xác là: Working in small cross-functional teams.
